title: MixTriad: three-stage mixed-methods triangulation (regression, gradient boosting, fsQCA)
description: Reproducible Python pipeline chaining parametric regression, Bayesian-optimized gradient boosting with a leakage-safe repeated hold-out protocol, and a complete fuzzy-set QCA engine (direct calibration, necessity analysis, truth table, Quine-McCluskey minimization). Developed alongside a study of the virality of AI-generated misinformation short videos; domain-agnostic by design.
